library.name: Stratum Praxis Systems Library
library.tagline: Small, verified systems you drop into an AI pipeline.

license_tiers.name: MIT
license_tiers.summary: Use, modify and redistribute, including commercially, in personal, business and client work. Keep the copyright and licence notice.
license_tiers.note: This is the only tier currently offered for the packaged systems, and the reason is factual rather than generous: the source repository is public and MIT-licensed, so those files are already MIT to everyone. A restrictive tier would not be enforceable on published versions.

license_tiers.name: Single-user product licence
license_tiers.summary: One buyer, one-time purchase, buyer-only workspace. The existing terms on the product page govern; nothing here changes them.

prohibited_uses: reselling the package source as your own product
redistributing it on a marketplace as an original work
sharing paid-product access credentials or buyer tokens
sublicensing paid products beyond the terms on their own product page
claiming authorship or white-label ownership of work you did not write

products.title: Truth Gate
products.summary: Stops an AI publishing pipeline from inventing a life it did not live: unevidenced first-person claims, fabricated biography and private data are refused with a named safe rewrite.
products.price_note: Free and MIT-licensed. See the licence page for why this is not a paid tier.
products.estimated_setup_time: 20-40 minutes, almost all of it writing an honest identity contract

products.title: Duplicate Guard
products.summary: Stops your own content from competing with itself: source echo, copy-spin, literal translations, repeated headlines and two live items chasing one audience with one CTA.
products.price_note: Free and MIT-licensed. See the licence page for why this is not a paid tier.
products.estimated_setup_time: 30-60 minutes, mostly shaping your published catalogue into the item shape
requirements: a list of what you have already published

products.title: Attribution Contract
products.summary: One routing table, identical tracked links every time, a CI check that fails when a CTA would arrive unattributed, and a funnel that reports NOT_MEASURED instead of inventing a rate.
products.price_note: Free and MIT-licensed. See the licence page for why this is not a paid tier.
products.estimated_setup_time: 20-30 minutes to declare your channels, longer if your existing tags need reconciling
requirements: a decision about what your channels are called

products.title: AI Workflow Operator Bundle
products.summary: Three operating systems for workflow architecture, AI/tool routing and company knowledge — with ownership, failure handling, QA and human approval boundaries written in.
products.price_note: Existing published price. Not set or changed by this work.
products.estimated_setup_time: immediate; it is a system to run, not code to install
requirements: access to a general-purpose chat model
products.delivery_note: Stripe purchase, then a Cloudflare Worker verifies the paid session and purchase email before issuing a signed token for the buyer-only workspace.
products.reuse_note: Existing live product. The Systems Library links to its canonical page and its existing checkout. No page, price or checkout was created or changed.

products.title: Cross-Agent Operating Kit
products.summary: Keep Brain, Policy, Skills and State portable across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and future agent runtimes, with human gates, cost guards and a migration path.
products.price_note: Entry tier of three published tiers ($69 / $149 / $299). Existing published prices, not set or changed by this work.
products.estimated_setup_time: a working session; it is an operating kit, not code to install
requirements: at least one agent runtime you already use
products.delivery_note: Stripe purchase, then the Cloudflare Worker verifies the paid session and purchase email at /cross-agent-kit/login before issuing a signed token for the buyer-only workspace.
products.reuse_note: Existing live product already on main. Carried into the generated hub so the page that replaces main's hand-written /systems/index.html does not drop it. Its page, tiers and checkouts are untouched; all three tiers are sold on that page.

products.title: AI Operations Systems Pack
products.summary: Ten operating systems for running AI work as an operation rather than a series of one-off requests.
products.price_note: Existing published price. Not set or changed by this work.
products.estimated_setup_time: immediate; it is a system to run, not code to install
requirements: access to a general-purpose chat model
products.delivery_note: Stripe purchase, then the Cloudflare Worker verifies the paid session and purchase email at /prompt-store/ops10/login before issuing a signed token for the buyer-only workspace.
products.reuse_note: Existing live product already on main. main's hand-written hub linked /prompt-store/ops10/, which has no page - the worker serves only /prompt-store/ops10/login and /workspace under that path. This links /prompt-store/operations-10.html, the real sales page.

deferred.reason: Four-file policy coupling; clean-room cost is high and the product is hard to explain without the surrounding engine.
Inseparable from a populated asset inventory; packaging it would ship an empty scoring engine.
Needs an owner decision: it calls a third-party AI API, which puts the buyer's cost and terms-of-service position on the seller.
Nothing survives genericisation; it would be new writing presented as an extraction.
Duplicate of the already-live AI Workflow Operator Bundle.
